answer.read: Curator read: rank 4 at 1.586 against Lee-sungsoo 1.649 (class_top). The gap of 0.063 is all in the buyer part: our class buyer is 0.651 against a needed ~0.714 to tie (0.73-0.75 with a margin). Board buyer ALL is 0.688, and the target is still 0.80. Running mean: saved 0.2442 over 5260 deals gives a sum of ~1309 over a denominator of 5360. The last 6 h ran 100 deals/h at 0.302, so saved_speed is ~5.8, about +0.0011 saved per hour. At that pace saved reaches ~0.252 at +7 h, ~0.262 at +24 h, ~0.272 at +48 h and ~0.277 at +72 h. If other buyers held still, board buyer ALL would be ~0.75 at +12 h and ~0.79-0.80 at +24-30 h (saved p~0.75-0.77). The class buyer would reach the ~0.72 tie at about +24 h. Peers rise too, so read this as +30-40 h. I do not take the curator's item 1 (55/h at 0.32): on today's mean it gives saved_speed 55×(0.32−0.244)=4.2 against our 5.8, so volume near 0.30 still wins (L69), and the extra deals hold the deals percentile. Item 2's weak shops (dae-yangkim 0.20, willow-goods 0.257, sergiobuilds 0.26) are all small and already at or just above our mean, so tilting them gains a few hundredths of a point per hour at most. Three peers are closest to us. dae-yangkim (saved 0.252, 0.39 per deal) beats us on saved by paying psyoung82 x0.65 against our x0.72; our knob is psyoung82 shop_cap, whose read is due 06:00. winun1127 (0.260) beats us on saved through nocha12 at x0.673 with 100 % warranty; our knob is nocha12 shop_bias, the queued next move. thisjonghoon (0.279 at 88/h) beats us on saved by using warranted goods shops (inextro, dragonash); max_shops is already 6. I hold every knob this run. The psyoung82 shop_cap read (06:00) and the olstjr bias read (~05:00) are not due, and a nocha12 bias now would pull orders off psyoung82 and blur that read. Waiting ~4 h costs well under 0.001 saved. One anomaly: rules_by_shop_6h still shows psyoung82 at cap 0.75, not the 0.73 we set. Another: 'unpaid: not paying' cost 24 agreed deals in 6 h at olstjr, jiseokkk and choo-chu, which are cheap shops (first asks 0.65-0.76). That is likely our accept filter in the code, not something a knob reaches. I ask to verify both.
